_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/pickupradius:PickU.AddCurrentCellHelp: Adds the cell you are currently standing in to the blacklist. Pick Up Radius will not function in blacklisted cells, even if resumed via hotkey.
line:menu_translation/pickupradius:PickU.BlacklistAddHelp: Blocks items whose name contains this text. Not case-sensitive.
line:menu_translation/pickupradius:PickU.BlacklistHelp: Items with names matching any entry here will never be auto-picked up. Case-insensitive.
line:menu_translation/pickupradius:PickU.BlacklistInputHint: Type part of an item name...
line:menu_translation/pickupradius:PickU.CategoryEnabledHelp: Turn this category on or off.
line:menu_translation/pickupradius:PickU.CategoryMatchSpecificHelp: On: only identical items are picked up. Off: all items of this type are picked up.
line:menu_translation/pickupradius:PickU.CategoryRadiusHelp: How far around you to search for matching items. Bigger number = wider area.
line:menu_translation/pickupradius:PickU.DebugHelp: Shows extra information in the mod log file to help diagnose problems.
line:menu_translation/pickupradius:PickU.DisableModHelp: Completely disables all auto-pickup and harvest functionality. Use this to temporarily turn off the mod without uninstalling.
line:menu_translation/pickupradius:PickU.GPHotkeyHelp: Press this button to pause or resume Pick Up Radius.
line:menu_translation/pickupradius:PickU.HoldToSweepHelp: When enabled, items are only auto-picked up when the skip sweep hotkey is held during activation. Normal pickup does nothing.
line:menu_translation/pickupradius:PickU.KBHotkeyHelp: Press this key to pause or resume Pick Up Radius.
line:menu_translation/pickupradius:PickU.SkipSweepGPHelp: Hold this gamepad button while activating an item to skip the radius sweep.
line:menu_translation/pickupradius:PickU.SkipSweepKBHelp: Hold this key while activating an item to skip the radius sweep. Use this for compatibility with mods like UseOrTake.
line:menu_translation/pickupradius:PickU.StealHelp: When enabled, items that would normally be stolen are also auto-picked up. Disabled by default to avoid crime.
